title: approvals: My Pending and the bell surface `admin_rescue` requests to a caller who can decide them (the console half of the rescue-queue arm)
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#22725
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/cloud#2709

Filing gate ①: the console half of finding C-01. Filed by the triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`), splitting objectstack-ai/objectstack#22722 (the maintainer's HotCRM browser pass, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2058, measured on `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Read on objectui `main` `ce991bd70f`

- My Pending is `apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` (about `:1196`, `:1226`, `:1311`).
- The bell count is `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts` (`approverIdentities` about `:516`, `useSharedPendingApprovalsCount` about `:533`–`:560`); see also `approvalRequestsDataSource.ts` about `:171`.
- Both ask by the caller's approver identities, so a rescue request is never included.

## Done when

- My Pending and the bell include the requests the server's rescue arm returns (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22725). A badge or label says this is an admin rescue.
- Pins:
  - a rescue request is listed and counted for an override actor;
  - CONTROL: a member's queue is unchanged.

**Why it also waits on cloud#2709:** cloud serves objectui `main` over a v17 runtime that does not know the new query parameter. The console starts asking only when the hosted runtime answers it.

`domain:ui` · p2.
